speaker: System Admin
text: Welcome to the Data Core — the central hub of the Nexus. Everything flows through here.

speaker: System Admin
text: Lately, corrupted processes have been multiplying. The Kernel — our central controller — has gone rogue.

speaker: System Admin
text: If we don't stop it, the entire Nexus will crash. And when a virtual world crashes... its inhabitants don't come back.

speaker: System Admin
text: At the top of the Nexus Spire. But the path is blocked by firewalls and corrupted zones. You'll need to fight your way through.

speaker: System Admin
text: Clear out the Bit Bugs infesting the network, then push through the Firewall Fortress and the Glitch Wastes. The Spire awaits beyond.

speaker: Network Engineer
text: The firewalls were supposed to protect us. Now they attack anything that moves — even friendlies.

speaker: Network Engineer
text: The Kernel reprogrammed them. If you can take down the Firewall Drone Commander, I can open a path to the Glitch Wastes.

speaker: Archivist
text: I used to catalog every byte of data in this world. Now half of it is scattered or corrupted.

speaker: Archivist
text: If you find any data fragments out there, bring them to me. Every piece recovered is a life preserved.

speaker: Pixel Merchant
text: Welcome to the Pixel Bazaar! Best digital wares in the Nexus. Everything's for sale — if you've got the fragments.

speaker: Pixel Merchant
text: Circuit boards, nano fibers, energy cells — I've got it all. The Glitch Wastes are dangerous, but the loot is worth it.
